// diagnostic

E0360

No `{symbol}` operator is defined for `{type}`.

What

No `{symbol}` operator is defined for `{type}`.

Why

User arithmetic dispatches only through the matching fixed operator trait hook; the compiler does not guess a method or fall through to rustc.

Fix

Implement the named `Type.Trait` hook, or call a named method instead.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0360: tests/ui/operator_missing_hook.stderr.

Error [E0360]: no `+` operator is defined for `Vec2`
  --> tests/ui/operator_missing_hook.jet:9:11
    |
  9 |     print(a + b)
    |           ^^^^^
 Why: user arithmetic dispatches only through one `impl Vec2.Add` hook
 Fix: implement `Vec2.Add`, or call a named method
